complianceReferences.title: National Ambient Air Quality Standards — PM2.5 (24-Hour Average)
complianceReferences.applicability: Industrial, Residential, Rural and other areas
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: 24-hour average shall not exceed 60 µg/m³ for 98% of the days in a year. Exceedance indicates severe respiratory risk.

complianceReferences.title: National Ambient Air Quality Standards — PM10 (24-Hour Average)
National Ambient Air Quality Standards — Sulfur Dioxide (SO2)
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Prevalent indicator of heavy fuel oil combustion and chemical plant emissions.

complianceReferences.title: National Ambient Air Quality Standards — Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2)
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: High levels correspond to vehicular density and high-temperature furnace flue exhausts.

complianceReferences.title: Inland Surface Water Quality — Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)
complianceReferences.standardCode: CPCB Designated Best Use Class C / General Effluent Standard 30 mg/L
complianceReferences.applicability: Drinking water source after conventional treatment / surface discharge
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Values above 3 mg/L indicate organic sewage or food-processing effluent influx.

complianceReferences.title: Industrial Effluent Discharge Standard — Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD)
complianceReferences.issuingAuthority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
complianceReferences.jurisdiction: Industrial Estates discharging to inland surface drains
complianceReferences.applicability: Common Effluent Treatment Plant (CETP) & Direct Discharge
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Values exceeding 250 mg/L signal non-biodegradable refractory toxic organic chemicals.

complianceReferences.title: Surface Water & Effluent pH Permissible Limits
complianceReferences.applicability: Treated effluent and inland waters (6.5 to 8.5)
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: pH < 6.5 or > 8.5 induces severe biological shock to aquatic ecosystems.

complianceReferences.title: General Standards for Discharge of Toxic Heavy Metals — Lead (Pb)
complianceReferences.standardCode: EP Rules 1986 Schedule VI Part A
complianceReferences.jurisdiction: Industrial discharge into public sewers / inland waters
complianceReferences.applicability: Battery recycling, electroplating, and chemical pigment manufacturing
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Cumulative neurotoxin with stringent zero-tolerance compliance thresholds.

complianceReferences.title: Ambient Noise Standards — Industrial Area (Daytime)
complianceReferences.issuingAuthority: The Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Continuous sound pressure level above 75 dB(A) necessitates acoustic enclosures and acoustic baffles.

complianceReferences.title: Ambient Noise Standards — Residential Area (Nighttime)
complianceReferences.issuingAuthority: The Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Night noise violation triggers immediate police and municipal action under EP Act 1986 Section 15.

complianceReferences.title: Solid Waste Management (SWM) Rules — Open Burning Prohibition
complianceReferences.applicability: Commercial, municipal, and industrial garbage dumps
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Absolute prohibition on burning solid waste, biomass, plastic, or leaves on public or private land.

complianceReferences.title: Volatile Organic Compounds (VOC) Ambient Fugitive Limit
complianceReferences.applicability: Distilleries, paint manufacturing, chemical storage tanks
complianceReferences.applicabilityNotes: Fugitive emissions of benzene, toluene, and solvent vapors causing eye irritation and chronic toxicity.

anomalies.potentialExplanation: Sudden high-volume boiler startup with wet scrubber bypass using non-compliant petcoke fuel.
anomalies.recommendedFollowUp: Issue immediate emergency stack shutdown directive under Air Act Section 31A.

anomalies.potentialExplanation: Direct batch dump of concentrated textile dye rinse effluent through concealed storm culvert.
anomalies.recommendedFollowUp: Deploy mechanical pipe plug to isolate drainage sector and trace upstream textile dye units.

anomalies.potentialExplanation: Severely punctured industrial sludge drums leaching battery recycling slag into fractured basalt aquifer.
anomalies.recommendedFollowUp: Deploy emergency hazmat overpack recovery team with contaminated soil excavation protocol.

anomalies.potentialExplanation: Acute microbial deoxygenation driven by sudden influx of untreated organic wastewater slurry.
anomalies.recommendedFollowUp: Audit municipal and CETP discharge gates upstream along Ulhas estuary.
